intro: Durable and thoughtfully designed, Kidmax brings imagination to life with playful prints and child-friendly features. A low-height hanging rail and multiple compartments make it easy for kids to organise clothes, toys and school essentials—keeping everyday routines simple, engaging and fun.

features.title: Playful charm, bright and cheerful
features.text: Into the Woods offers a serene, nature-inspired aesthetic. Tall tree silhouettes and a quiet stag sit against the Stormy Weather base, creating a grounded, peaceful look. Its muted tones and clean composition make it a fitting choice for modern, minimalist kids’ rooms.

features.title: Thoughtfully designed for kids
features.text: The wardrobe comes with a child-friendly layout, featuring a low-height hanging rail for easy access, multiple compartments for organising clothes, toys and school essentials, and a spacious top shelf ideal for bags, blankets and storage boxes.

features.title: Keep everything safe and secure
features.text: Rest easy knowing your essentials are secure. With a reliable recessed aluminium door lock, this almirah keeps your valuables safe, giving you peace of mind with every use.

features.title: Ideal for compact spaces
features.text: Perfect for small rooms or tight spaces, the Slimline Almirah is designed to fit seamlessly into your kids' room. Its sleek profile maximises your available space while offering ample storage.

features.title: Strength that stands the test
features.text: Crafted from strong, resilient CRCA steel, this almirah offers lasting durability. It’s an investment in quality that will keep your space tidy and secure for years to come.

name: Kidmax Nx Into The Woods Digital Printed 2-Door Steel Almirah Stormy Weather
